title: Paul Lee v. Korean Southwest Presbytery
disposition_detail: The SJC sustained all five appellate issues, set aside Presbytery’s judgment, dismissed the charges concerning Executive Committee citations and Admonition Committee exhortations, revoked both definite and automatic indefinite suspension, and remanded the inappropriate-language charge for retrial or dismissal.
first_summary: A minister appealed convictions on three charges and a definite suspension that would become indefinite absent repentance. The SJC sustained the appeal because unauthorized citations and admonition without process could not support guilt, while disqualification, deficient recording, premature findings, denial of cross-examination, and improper trial management fatally prejudiced the proceeding. It dismissed two charges, revoked the censures, and remanded the inappropriate-language charge.
summary: A minister appealed three convictions and suspension that would automatically become indefinite absent repentance. The SJC sustained the appeal: unauthorized committee citations and admonition without process could not support guilt, and multiple trial violations were fatally prejudicial. It set aside the judgment, dismissed the citation and admonition charges, and revoked both censures. The inappropriate-language charge was not adjudicated on its merits; Presbytery could retry it on remand or dismiss it.

sources.supports: Case identity, appeal, charges and censures, five sustained issues, adopted reasoning, dismissal of two charges, revocation of censures, and remand options.

evidence_notes.identity_and_adoption: The caption identifies Judicial Case 2003-3 as Paul Lee’s appeal against Korean Southwest Presbytery; the panel decision was adopted 19-0 (lines 13–17, 129–131).
evidence_notes.dispute: Presbytery convicted Lee on three charges and imposed definite suspension followed conditionally by indefinite suspension (lines 17–21, 52–63).
evidence_notes.outcomes_and_reasons: All five issues were answered yes; unauthorized citations, admonition without process, prejudicial trial violations, and an improper censure required relief (lines 64–70, 76–127).
evidence_notes.qualifications: The remaining inappropriate-language charge was remanded for retrial or, alternatively, dismissal; the decision did not determine its merits (lines 123–127).
evidence_notes.incorporated_decisions: No external decision was incorporated by reference; the SJC adopted the supplied unanimous panel decision (lines 129–131).

source_limits: The source supplies the adopted panel opinion and vote but not the complete record of the case; the opinion itself notes that Presbytery’s trial record was incomplete.

score_reasons.decision: Preserves dismissal, vacatur of judgment and censures, and limited remand.
score_reasons.decisive_reason: States both the unauthorized pretrial measures and fatally prejudicial trial violations.
score_reasons.distinctive_value: Clarifies that committee compulsion and admonition lacked authority or process and that the remaining charge was unresolved.

verification_notes: Rechecked the five affirmative judgments and adopted relief. The final summary clarifies that only two charges were dismissed, both censures were revoked, and the inappropriate-language charge could be retried or dismissed rather than being finally resolved.
